scripts.db:migrate:local: cd apps/worker && for f in migrations-pg/*.sql; do psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$f"; done
scripts.db:migrate:remote: cd apps/worker && for f in migrations-pg/*.sql; do psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$f"; done
scripts.e2e:server: cd apps/worker && bunx wrangler dev --local --port 8799 --var APP_ENV:e2e
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run --filter @raisai/worker deploy
